premises.text: Most companies have been or will be breached; encryption is the most effective mitigation of breach cost
premises.evidence_span: More than 60% of companies have already been breached

premises.text: Never-decrypt cloud database keeps data encrypted at rest, in transit, and in memory while still allowing private search and fetch with no application changes and no key reveal
premises.evidence_span: Calypso is the first never decrypt cloud database solution. So the data remains encrypted, addressed, in transit, and in memory at the database storage

premises.text: Docker intercepts and encrypts data streams in real time so unauthorized users including admins and cloud providers see only ciphertext
premises.evidence_span: Our Docker intercepts the data stream and encrypts the data in real time before storing it

premises.text: SQL analytics run on encrypted data with dynamic re-encryption after queries
premises.evidence_span: on top of this encrypted data, and while they are encrypted, someone can run SQL queries

premises.text: Combines AES with oblivious RAM and differential privacy for efficient secure indexing, delivering true security at much higher speeds than peers
premises.evidence_span: we combine cryptography, so oblivious RAM, with differential privacy in order to ensure an efficient and secure indexing of these records

premises.text: Go-to-market via financial services, cloud-native companies, and database providers as channel partners
premises.evidence_span: we're working with direct engagements with financial services, medium-sized, cloud-native companies, and also database providers as channel partners

value.text: True security that lets products differentiate for clients while keeping cloud data usable
value.evidence_span: help you differentiate your products for your clients based on true security

causal_links.evidence_span: Encryption is the most effective measure in mitigating this risk
We are a private search engine on top of encrypted data

notes: Private-search and never-decrypt claims kept as core product premise; Docker path and SQL-on-ciphertext treated as distinct operational capabilities.
